text:
Elaine: Heads up 1 finalizing registration copy + lead-routing rules for the webinar. Need short hero blurb for landing page, 2 email subject options, 3 social snippets, and routing tags for incoming signups. Also confirm speaker recording permissions.

Kai: Quick hero idea: "Build cost-predictable LLM features: real-world latency, routing, and failover patterns you can ship today." Short and benefit-led.

Sam: Love it. Two email subject lines: 1) "How we cut token cost by 3x without losing latency" 2) "Ship reliable LLM features: lessons from production" Which tone do we want, urgent or educational?

Elaine: Educational first, urgent in follow-ups. Use subj1 for the nurture invite, subj2 for the reminder 48h.

Jess: Social snippets: (a) "Live demo: fallback flows & routing policies that keep your app online. Join our engineers." (b) "Benchmarks you can trust 1 what matters at 99th percentile latency." (c) "Want predictable inference costs? See practical knobs in action." Keep them short for X/Twitter.

Mohit: For lead routing: map registrant fields -> tags. Suggested tags: ["interest:dedicated", "interest:private", "usecase:chatbot", "usecase:search", "company_size:enterprise", "utm_campaign:webinar_march"]. Routing rule: if company_size=enterprise OR interest:private -> route to AE queue "enterprise-infer" else route to SDRs.

Kai: Add a simple hidden field on registration for "deployment priority" so CS can segment later (options: PoC, Prod, Evaluating).

Sam: Speaker recording permission: confirm we can record and reuse clips. Speakers ok?

Jess: I can record and give marketing clip rights. Also propose we capture a 30s soundbite post-rehearsal for the promo.

Elaine: Good. Sam, Mohit confirm?

Sam: Confirmed. Mohit: confirmed.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for follow-up tasks: poll for recording consent -> 1770090000.

Mohit: Landing page microcopy: 2-line deck: "Join Redwood engineers to see production inference patterns: routing, batching, and graceful fallbacks. Includes reproducible benchmarks and a live demo." CTA: "Reserve your spot". Under CTA add small line: "Recording provided; live Q&A at the end."

Kai: We should also add an audience line: "For ML engineers & platform teams building LLM-powered features." That helps set expectations and improve conversion.

Sam: Promo schedule: send invites Mon (educational subject), reminder Wed (urgent subject), final reminder 2h before. Also push 3 social posts: 7 days, 3 days, and day-of.

Jess: Rehearsal windows: speaker-only dry run 8:15 PT day-of, full run + tech check 9:00 PT day-of, pre-record clip review by Thu EOD. Can everyone make those?

Elaine: Yes for me. Jess, Kai can you do Thu clip review?

Kai: Yep I'll review Thu.

Sam: Small lead-gen nuance: append hidden utm param utm_content=speaker_{first_initial} so we can attribute which speaker drove signups via social. Example utm_content=speaker_s.

Mohit: Analytics: mark form submissions with transcript_consent boolean and routing_tag list. Also pipe registrant email domain to platform team for potential on-prem interest signals.

Elaine: Action items: Sam -> draft landing page + email HTML by EOD Fri; Kai -> add registration hidden fields and utm_content param; Mohit -> implement routing rules in HubSpot and test; Jess -> upload 30s promo clip and confirm recording permission check; Ops-bot -> schedule recording consent ping.

Sam: I'll put all copy in the shared doc and add two A/B subject lines for the nurture flow. Link: https://tinyurl.com/webinar-promo-copy

Elaine: Great. Last note: let's include a small attendee CTA matrix on the thank-you page so we can route warm leads: "Try Redwood (free trial)", "Request private deployment info", "Book a 30-min technical demo". Those map to routing tags.

Jess: Agree. Also add an inline slide download CTA and tag clicks as cta:deck_download.

Mohit: I'll setup the mapping and test with 3 dummy submissions.

ops-bot: Tasks created: webinar-landing-copy, registration-fields, hubspot-routing, promo-clip, consent-ping. Due dates set per assignees.

Elaine: Thanks team 1 if no blockers I'll publish the landing draft tomorrow morning and we can start the drip. :thumbsup:
